mechanism: Cenobamate induces CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially reducing bupropion plasma concentrations and its active metabolites, while bupropion may inhibit CYP2D6 causing increased cenobamate levels.
action: Monitor bupropion efficacy closely; dose adjustment may be needed; therapeutic drug monitoring recommended if available; assess for seizure breakthrough or bupropion loss of effect.
